findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ask_pipeworx, deep_research, subscribe, list_subscriptions, recent_alerts, bet_research, polymarket_fill_risk, pipeworx_feedback · Private data: ask_pipeworx, search_within, deep_research, entity_profile, validate_claim, bet_research, polymarket_arbitrage, polymarket_kalshi_spread, generate_llms_txt, pipeworx_feedback · Public sink: subscribe, polymarket_kalshi_spread, polymarket_fill_risk, remember · Destructive: polymarket_edges, polymarket_kalshi_spread, generate_llms_txt, remember, recall, forget.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ask_pipeworx, deep_research, subscribe, list_subscriptions, recent_alerts, bet_research, polymarket_fill_risk, pipeworx_feedback · Private data: ask_pipeworx, search_within, deep_research, entity_profile, validate_claim, bet_research, polymarket_arbitrage, polymarket_kalshi_spread, generate_llms_txt, pipeworx_feedback · Public sink: subscribe, polymarket_kalshi_spread, polymarket_fill_risk, remember · Destructive: polymarket_edges, polymarket_kalshi_spread, generate_llms_txt, remember, recall, forget

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
